_what_this_is: A template for a run over Bedrock Converse, not a receipt. Every <angle-bracketed> value is a placeholder, which the reader refuses as evidence. Fill it in inside the private environment, keep it there, and validate it with 'py -3.10 -m harness.commands.execution_receipt'. The validator refuses a receipt stored inside this repository. Converse runs no child process, so this receipt carries no CLI version and no argv; it records the request the transport builds.
authored_on: <the date it was filled in, YYYY-MM-DD>
purpose: <the run this receipt is readiness evidence for>

processing_route.authority: <the private environment's own rule that permits this processing, named>
processing_route.processing: <what that rule permits to be sent to the provider>
processing_route.export: <what that rule permits to leave the environment>

model_identity.note: A declared identifier. The provider attests nothing on this transport.

rendered_request.temperature: <the inferenceConfig.temperature the request carries, as a number>
rendered_request.max_tokens: <the inferenceConfig.maxTokens the request carries, as a number>

evidence: <how the blindness was verified: the tests read, the rendered request inspected>

checkpoint.path: <where the run will write its checkpoint, under the private clone>

preflight.report_path: <the preflight report, absolute or relative to this receipt>
preflight.import_manifest_sha256: <its sha256, as the preflight pinned it>
